cases.contactMeaning: Fully hand-owned centroid distance is diagnostic only. Natural palm/thumb-web targets and intentional parked/stowed props require independent measured and visual review.

limits: No Art PASS is inferred from capture completion. Review actual images before acceptance.
No account, database, shop purchase, storage transaction, quest reward, Meshy/API or server flow is invoked.
SwiftShader frame times are not production performance measurements. Finite vertices do not prove skin strain, anatomy or planted-foot contacts.
Fully hand-owned centroid/prop alignment is measured at rendered poses. It cannot prove a closed grip, natural digits, anatomical thumb or weapon edge direction. Those remain image review gates.
